reviews.text: Thank you for your feedback, Juan. The entire team at Archiduque Carlos Veterinary Hospital is proud to receive such a comment. Best regards.
They did quite good tests on her and we got the results in a short time.

We took our little Choco in when he was very sick, and thanks to the doctor's good judgment, they decided to operate. Luckily, he's already improving and isn't in pain. Now we just have to wait and see if everything continues to go well. ❤️ We want to express our heartfelt gratitude for the care he received and for looking after our little one so well. We are so grateful for everything. ❤️🐶

I took my dog ​​to the vet on a Sunday to get antibiotics for mastitis. They refused to see her because it wasn't "urgent enough." I had to find another vet, who told me it was very urgent to start treatment as soon as possible and confirm that it was mastitis and not a tumor. I'm currently waiting for the test results. I don't recommend going to this 24-hour emergency vet; if they don't consider it urgent, they won't even examine the animal.

Excellent service and very humane treatment. We had to go in an emergency because my dog ​​ingested some household insecticidal gel, and they attended to us very quickly. The treatment was impeccable; they genuinely cared about my pet, and they showed me a great deal of empathy during a very stressful time. The emergency consultation cost €110. My only constructive criticism was that I found it a little strange that they didn't ask me more questions about the active ingredient in the gel, but the overall and medical care was excellent. Highly recommended.

Nairobi couldn't be saved last Friday. But I am incredibly grateful for the treatment, empathy, and care she received.

Thank you for trying.
My heart is broken, but that doesn't diminish the kindness you showed us.
Here's her last photo on the way to the hospital…
No comment... The treatment was terrible.
Terrible treatment from the girl who was there today, September 26th at 9:15 pm. People like that make us choose another place to take our pet. Unbelievable how little manners that girl had.

I've always taken my animals there, but this last time I didn't like their way of working. I took my cat in because he couldn't breathe, and instead of telling me he was dying and that I should take him and let him die with me, all they did during the two hours he was in agony was run tests to squeeze as much money out of me as possible... what a disappointment. I'm not going back.

I've been twice during normal hours and it was great, but once I went in an emergency because my dog ​​had a reaction to two medications, with rapid breathing and a racing heart while he was sleeping—basically, a drop in blood pressure. The woman there told me she was a dentist and that it would be better if I went to a specialist on Monday. I said, "Excuse me? Aren't you right across the street?" With a shameful attitude of not wanting to work, I went to another clinic.

Outrageous. They charged us for the hospitalization day of January 22, 2026, even though we had our cat euthanized there on the night of January 21. They charged us for a day of service after her death and never refunded the money.

I've never written a review before, but unfortunately, today's situation warrants it. Last Sunday, we took our dog to this clinic for emergency care because he was complaining of pain, vomiting, and diarrhea. They supposedly ran a series of tests (blood work and an X-ray). According to them, everything was fine, and they sent him home. It's worth noting that, besides charging us almost 600 euros, they asked us what our budget was, and we told them to run all the necessary tests. Well, today, less than a week later, my dog ​​is hospitalized with pancreatitis (obviously at a different veterinary clinic). If you truly love and care about your pets, don't take them here. They are scammers and unscrupulous. We will obviously be taking legal action.

I took my dog ​​for a general check-up and also to see if he had hypothyroidism and Cushing's syndrome. According to them, they took blood from his neck, even though he has a lot of hair there and there's no blood, nor did they take blood from his neck or anywhere else. The bill they gave me as soon as I arrived was almost €450, an outrageous price, a complete rip-off. And they haven't given me the results of the hypothyroidism or Cushing's tests, nor the medication. Besides, they told me to come back today, Monday, September 7th, so they could take blood three times and do an x-ray, and thank goodness I called because they didn't even have it on file. All this to say, €450 for the test is insane, an absolute rip-off, and on top of that, I don't even know if the test was for another dog.

Please don't come here, you'll be ruined. I saw that you charged someone else €232 for a blood test and me €450. I'm going to report you for fraud because you didn't take blood from my dog ​​at all and gave me the test results of another dog. Besides, the email you sent me about just one test, which didn't refer to my dog ​​but to all dogs and cats, makes no sense. Unbelievable! I'm going to report you!!
Thank you so much, Edward, for trusting Archiduque Carlos Veterinary Hospital in Valencia. Hugs!

After waiting an hour and a half, we went to another hospital. The thing is, there was a dog ahead of us, but between tests, they managed to give my dog ​​a quick check-up. I've always been loyal to this clinic with my current dog and with my previous one, who sadly is no longer with us.
I don't think I'll be returning to this clinic, unfortunately. Being professional also means being involved, if you'll pardon the redundancy. Thank you.

On August 15th, we had an emergency with our cat. I must say that the initial care was adequate. However, the diagnosis was a disaster. They started by saying she needed surgery and to be transferred to Torrent, all this at midnight on August 15th. They left our cat to spend a pointless night there because we took her home the next day, and in the end, there was no need for surgery. And obviously, all of this came at a high cost and with an inaccurate diagnosis.
If you have an emergency, this is the place to take your pet. They treated me well and in a friendly manner.

Beware, our vet was on vacation. We took our pet to the vet through our insurance, and after several visits, they decided to admit him. They charged us 1000 euros (money I didn't care about) and discharged him worse than when he came in. After a day of him getting progressively worse, we decided to take him to another vet, and I couldn't believe they had discharged him without prescribing antibiotics. Unfortunately, our pet died. We will never take any animal to this clinic again.

This is the usual veterinary clinic for the pets we've had at home. Carlos almost always treated us there, and he was really good. Now, Sonia and Diana usually take care of us, and they're both fantastic. This time, Carmen saw Black M., and I have to say she was just as wonderful as the others. Thank you so much for your empathy towards animals.
Thank you so much, Diana, for trusting Archiduque Carlos Veterinary Hospital in Valencia. Hugs!
Very good veterinarians.
Excellent service and professionalism. I take my dogs there regularly and the attention is impeccable. Highly recommended.
Thank you, Zaira, for trusting our team at Archiduque Carlos Veterinary Hospital in Valencia and for valuing our work so highly. Your satisfaction is our greatest reward. Warm regards.
A professional and friendly service, highly recommended!
They stand out for their professionalism and kindness in treating our pets
Very professional, attentive and friendly, I will return
I took my dog ​​Tosca in for a uterine infection (they told me it was pyometra) and she had emergency surgery
Good veterinarians with experience and professionalism
Everything was great. Excellent service and, as always, Juanjo solved all my dog's problems.

Excellent service and treatment from the moment you walk through the emergency room door. Super professional, attentive, and incredibly caring towards our pets. You can see their dedication and love for what they do. Special mention to Juan José Brotons, the traumatologist at the Archiduque Carlos Hospital, who operated on my dog ​​for a radius fracture. He took the time to explain everything clearly and was attentive at all times. I highly recommend this hospital. They treat animals with loving care and people with respect and compassion. Thank you so much for everything.
